title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Legal Services for Promoting Rural Reform and Development
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Issuance of the Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Legal Services for Advancing Rural Reform and Development

Fa Fa [2008] No. 36

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Legal Services for Advancing Rural Reform and Development are hereby issued for your earnest implementation.

December 3, 2008

The Supreme People's Court

Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Legal Services for Advancing Rural Reform and Development

The Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China adopted the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Advancing Rural Reform and Development" (hereinafter referred to as the "Decision"). In order to implement the strategic deployment of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee, give fuller play to the trial function of the people's courts, and provide strong judicial guarantee and legal services for advancing rural reform and development, the following opinions are hereby proposed.

I. Deeply Understand the Important Significance of Implementing the Spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee

(1) The Spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee Represents Theoretical and Institutional Innovation in the Party's Rural Policies

The Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China profoundly summarized the great practice and basic experience of 30 years of rural reform and development, deeply analyzed the contradictions and problems currently facing rural reform and development, and comprehensively deployed the main tasks for advancing rural reform and development under the new situation from three aspects: strengthening rural institutional construction, actively developing modern agriculture, and accelerating the development of rural public utilities. The Decision adapts to the new situation of rural reform and development, responds to the new expectations of people of all ethnic groups, especially the hundreds of millions of farmers, for a better new life, and features new breakthroughs in understanding, new developments in theory, and new measures in policy. It is highly strategic, guiding, and targeted, and serves as an action program for promoting rural reform and development in the coming period. The new situation of rural reform and development sets new goals, tasks, and requirements for the work of the people's courts. People's courts at all levels must stand from a political and overall perspective, deeply comprehend the spirit of the plenary session, and earnestly grasp its implementation.

(2) Implementing the Spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee Is an Important Embodiment of the People's Courts' In-depth Study and Practice of the Scientific Outlook on Development

Advancing rural reform and development concerns the overall situation of comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable economic and social development in China. Integrating the work of the people's courts into the overall work of the Party and the state and providing strong judicial guarantee and legal services for advancing rural reform and development is an important part of the people's courts' current and future in-depth study and practice activities of the Scientific Outlook on Development, as well as an important opportunity for the scientific development of the people's courts' work. People's courts at all levels should, with a high sense of political responsibility and mission, take the implementation of the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee as an important point of integration for achieving the scientific development of the people's courts' work and a focal point for improving the work of the people's courts closely link providing judicial guarantee for advancing rural reform and development with in-depth study and practice activities of the Scientific Outlook on Development, so that society can truly feel the fruitful results achieved by the people's courts in their study and practice activities. We must firmly grasp this main line, conscientiously enhance judicial work capabilities, proactively carry out judicial services, and while achieving the scientific development of the people's courts' work, strive to provide strong judicial guarantee and legal services for rural reform and development.

II. Give Full Play to the Trial Function, Ensure the Vigorous Advancement of Rural Reform and Innovation and the Further Strengthening of Rural Institutional Construction

(1) Focus on Stabilizing and Improving the Basic Rural Management System

1. Intensify the trial of disputes over rural land contract management, fully protect all rights and interests of land contract management according to law, and maintain the stability and long-term unchanged nature of land contract relationships. The various rights and interests of land contract management are not only extremely important civil rights of the vast number of farmers but are also the basic conditions for building a new socialist countryside and constructing a rural social security system. The maintenance of land contract management rights is inseparable from the stability of contract relationships, and the stability and long-term unchanged nature of contract relationships are the legal premise and institutional guarantee for safeguarding farmers' land contract management rights. The trial and enforcement work of the people's courts shall be effectively strengthened with the core purpose of safeguarding farmers' various rights and interests in land contract management and maintaining the stability and long-term unchanged nature of land contract relationships, and with the ultimate goal of stabilizing and improving the basic rural management system and advancing rural reform and development.

2. Pay attention to protecting innovation in agricultural management institutions and mechanisms, and promote the transformation of agricultural management methods. The transformation of household contract management towards adopting advanced technology and market means, and the development of unified management towards a multi-level and multi-form management service system, are trends and inevitabilities in the innovation of agricultural management institutions and mechanisms and the transformation of agricultural management methods. Trial work shall be carried out in accordance with the principle of being conducive to improving the market intensification and organization of agriculture, providing escorts for the development of the collective economy and the accelerated development of specialized farmer cooperatives.

(2) Strive to Maintain a Strict and Standardized Rural Land Management System

1. Adhere to the strictest farmland protection system and the strictest land conservation system to ensure national food security. The land system is the basic system in rural areas and is the top priority among the "three rural issues." Farmland protection concerns national food security and is of extremely important significance to the national economy. In handling various types of cases involving farmland, especially basic farmland, the comprehensive trial functions of criminal, civil, and administrative trials shall be fully utilized to increase the crackdown and sanction on criminal offenses and illegal acts encroaching on farmland, maintain and support administrative organs in exercising their powers according to law, and ensure the achievement of the goal of "use control, economical use, and strict management" in farmland protection, and resolutely hold the red line of 1.8 billion mu of farmland.

2. Safeguard the various functions and powers of land contract management rights and protect farmers' various statutory rights over contracted land. The rights of possession, use, and proceeds over contracted land enjoyed by farmers as stipulated by laws such as the "Property Law" and the "Rural Land Contract Law" shall be implemented, providing comprehensive judicial protection. Special attention shall be paid to protecting the various rights and interests in land contract management of rural migrant workers and business operators to prevent them from becoming landless farmers and causing social problems.

3. Effectively protect and standardize the transfer of land contract management rights, and promote the establishment and improvement of the transfer market. In trying cases involving the transfer of land contract management rights, the provisions of the "Property Law," the "Rural Land Contract Law," and the judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on "Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Rural Land Contract Disputes" and other laws and judicial interpretations shall be strictly followed. Transfer acts that change the collective ownership nature of land, change land use, or harm farmers' land contract management rights shall be confirmed invalid according to law. Acts of illegally interfering with the transfer of land contract management rights shall be corrected according to law. In accordance with the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee and the provisions of relevant laws, the forms of transfer of land contract management rights shall be accurately defined. Where land contract management rights are transferred in the form of shareholding cooperation, the review shall focus on whether the shareholding act conforms to the will of the farmers, strictly preventing farmers from losing their land contract management rights due to shareholding cooperation.

4. Protect farmers' usufructuary rights in homesteads according to law, and promote the strict management and improvement of the homestead system. Homestead use rights carry the social function of ensuring that farmers have a place to live, and are an important part of the rural land management system. Transfers of homesteads that violate laws, administrative regulations, and relevant national policies, as well as other acts that indirectly lead to farmers losing homestead use rights, shall be confirmed invalid according to law. The trial and enforcement work of related cases shall be carried out with a focus on the strict management and improvement of the homestead system and the maintenance and protection of farmers' usufructuary rights in homesteads.

5. Properly handle cases related to the expropriation of rural collective land according to law, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of land-expropriated farmers. In accordance with the legally prescribed purposes and objectives of land expropriation, whether timely and full reasonable compensation has been provided to rural collective organizations and farmers based on the principle of same land same price, and whether the employment, housing, and social security issues of land-expropriated farmers have been properly resolved shall be taken as important bases for determining the legality of the expropriation act. In accordance with relevant provisions such as the judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on "Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Rural Land Contract Disputes," disputes over the distribution of land expropriation compensation fees shall be properly handled. Where cases involve the criteria for defining the membership qualifications of rural collective organization members, the legitimate rights and interests of farmers, especially women and children, shall be protected to the greatest extent possible within the existing legal framework.

6. Properly handle cases related to collective operational construction land, and promote the formation of a unified urban-rural construction land market. Provided that it conforms to land use planning, collective operational construction land shall be recognized as enjoying equal rights with state-owned land according to law. In trying cases involving disputes over collective operational construction land, both laws and administrative regulations shall be strictly implemented, and the relationship between laws, administrative regulations, policies, and institutional mechanism innovation shall be properly handled. Close attention shall be paid to the improvement and supporting measures of relevant laws, administrative regulations, and policy measures, so that the trial work does not affect the standardized advancement of the reform of the rural land management system.

(3) Properly Handle Cases Related to Agricultural Investment and Grain Subsidy Distribution, and Ensure the Implementation and Improvement of the Agricultural Support and Protection System

1. Severely punish economic crimes involving agricultural investment, and provide protection for the effective use of agricultural investment. In accordance with the spirit of the Decision, the growth rate of fiscal investment in agriculture at all levels will be higher than the growth rate of recurrent revenue, and the state's investment in rural infrastructure construction and the development of social undertakings will also increase significantly. Ensuring the effective use of agricultural investment is crucial to implementing the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee. Focus shall be placed on trying cases arising from the use of agricultural investment, and crimes of embezzlement, misappropriation, and corruption of agricultural investment funds shall be resolutely and severely cracked down upon according to law.

2. Increase the punishment of illegal and criminal acts involving grain subsidies, and ensure the timely and full distribution of grain subsidies. Implementing various agricultural subsidy systems is of great significance for supporting grain increase and income growth and protecting farmers' enthusiasm for growing grain. With the substantial annual increase in grain subsidies for farmers, the fight against illegal and criminal acts that hinder the grain subsidy system, such as interception and misappropriation, shall be intensified to effectively ensure that grain subsidies truly benefit farmers and agriculture.

(4) Properly Handle Rural Financial Cases According to Law, and Promote the Establishment of a Modern Rural Financial System

Rural finance is the core of the modern rural economy and also a bottleneck constraining rural reform and development. With the goals of preventing and resolving rural financial risks, stabilizing the rural financial market, broadening rural financing channels, standardizing and guiding more credit funds and social capital to flow into rural areas, various types of cases involving rural finance shall be properly handled according to law. The relevant provisions of laws, administrative regulations, and judicial interpretations shall be fully applied to equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of the parties, promote the establishment and improvement of the rural credit guarantee mechanism and the healthy development of private lending, severely crack down on crimes of misappropriating rural credit funds, illegally absorbing public deposits, and various other crimes endangering the rural financial order, promote the healthy and stable development of the rural financial market, and facilitate the establishment of a modern rural financial system.

(5) Safeguard the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Migrant Workers, and Promote the Integration of Urban and Rural Economic and Social Development

Fully implement the relevant provisions of laws, administrative regulations, and judicial interpretations to fully and timely protect the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers. In trying cases involving the protection of migrant workers' rights, the spirit of the relevant provisions of laws, administrative regulations, and judicial interpretations shall be accurately grasped, the relationship between the protection of migrant workers' legitimate rights and interests and the healthy development of enterprises shall be properly handled, and the organic unity of legal effect and social effect shall be strived for. For disputes over arrears of migrant workers' wages or labor remuneration with clear facts and clear legal relationships, as well as labor disputes involving migrant workers with property payment content, the efficiency of judicial protection shall be enhanced. Under the premise of ensuring justice, trials and enforcement shall be conducted quickly and promptly. Where legal conditions for advance execution are met, a ruling for advance execution shall be made promptly. The principle of equal protection according to law shall be adhered to in terms of labor conditions, production safety, labor remuneration, and work-related injury, medical, and endowment insurance, guiding and establishing a social concept of urban-rural equality, and making active efforts to promote the establishment of a unified urban-rural human resources market and the integration of urban and rural economic and social development.

(6) Protect Farmers' Democratic Rights, and Promote the Improvement of the Rural Democratic Management System

1. Effectively protect farmers' rights to information, participation, expression, and supervision. Various judicial trial methods shall be comprehensively used to protect farmers' exercise of various democratic rights according to law. In trying cases involving villagers' autonomy resolutions, as long as they do not violate the mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations, the validity of the villagers' autonomy resolution shall be respected and maintained. Where a villagers' autonomy resolution violates laws or administrative regulations and infringes upon the legitimate rights and interests of farmers, it shall be revoked according to law. Through the legal protection of farmers' democratic rights and other legitimate rights and interests, the continuous expansion of the scope of villagers' autonomy shall be promoted according to law, and the healthy and orderly development of the villagers' autonomy system shall be promoted.

2. Strengthen the propaganda of legal education in rural areas, and promote the rule of law in rural areas. Through various effective forms such as trial activities, legal education and propaganda shall be strengthened to promote the spirit of the rule of law, strengthen legal awareness, improve legal literacy, and continuously enhance the level of the rule of law in rural areas. Taking the trial and enforcement of hot and difficult issues and typical cases as a carrier, legal education and propaganda shall be closely linked to the specific circumstances of agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, enhancing the enthusiasm, initiative, pertinence, and effectiveness of the masses in knowing, trusting, and abiding by the law, and making the greatest possible effort to play the important role of the people's courts in promoting the governance of rural areas according to law.

III. Strengthen the Protection of Modern Agriculture, and Promote the Improvement of Comprehensive Agricultural Production Capacity

(1) Further Strengthen and Maintain the Order of the Agricultural Market, and Promote the Strategic Adjustment of the Agricultural Structure

1. Effectively protect the order of the market for elements of agricultural product production, and ensure the quality and safety of agricultural products. Crackdowns and sanctions on illegal and criminal acts that pollute agricultural product production areas, produce and sell prohibited, inferior, or agricultural inputs that do not meet national mandatory technical standards or safety standards shall be further intensified, the order of the agricultural materials market shall be regulated, and the quality and safety of agricultural products shall be ensured from the source.

2. Further regulate the market for crop and forest seeds, maintain the seed management system, and protect the vital interests of farmers. Through trial work, the state's seed production and operation licensing system shall be further safeguarded, and criminal acts that undermine the seed management system shall be severely cracked down upon. In trying civil and administrative cases arising from the production, processing, and sale of seeds, focus shall be placed on protecting the vital rights and interests of farmers and farming households, and acts that disrupt the order of the seed market shall be severely sanctioned.

3. Strengthen the trial of cases involving disputes arising from various links such as the production, processing, packaging, transportation, and sale of agricultural products, and maintain a healthy order for the transaction of agricultural products. The relevant provisions of the "Product Quality Law," the "Consumer Rights Protection Law," and other laws and administrative regulations shall be strictly implemented. Through the trial of cases, the rights and obligations of all parties in the circulation process of agricultural products shall be clarified, protecting both the personal safety and property rights of agricultural product consumers and adhering to the principle of each party bearing its own responsibility, clarifying the respective responsibilities of agricultural product purchasers, transporters, processors, and sellers, and promoting the further improvement of the agricultural product quality and safety system.

(2) Strengthen the Protection of Agricultural Intellectual Property Rights, and Provide Judicial Guarantee for Agricultural Science and Technology Innovation

1. Continue to strengthen the intellectual property protection of agricultural science and technology innovation achievements, and promote agricultural science and technology innovation. Agricultural scientific and technological progress is the fundamental way out for agricultural development, an important pathway to achieving national food security, and is also an important part of judicial protection of intellectual property rights. The trial of intellectual property cases involving agriculture shall be further strengthened, the protection of agricultural intellectual property rights, especially major agricultural scientific and technological achievements and new plant varieties with independent intellectual property rights, shall be enhanced, and various intellectual property crimes involving agriculture shall be severely cracked down upon according to law, and various intellectual property infringements and breaches of contract involving agriculture shall be sanctioned according to law.

2. Strictly implement the relevant provisions of laws and judicial interpretations, and strengthen the trial of technology contract dispute cases involving agriculture. The legitimate rights and interests of all relevant parties shall be protected according to law, and through judicial means, the establishment and improvement of the market for the transformation of agricultural technological achievements shall be promoted, forming a market mechanism and atmosphere that follows market rules and the principle of good faith.

3. Protect the effective use of the state's agricultural science and technology achievement transformation fund according to law, and promote the transformation of agricultural science and technology achievements. Criminal acts such as encroaching upon, stealing, defrauding, or illegally occupying agricultural science and technology achievement transformation funds by other means, or acts of falsification, dereliction of duty, or abuse of power for personal gain by state functionaries in the approval of agricultural science and technology achievement transformation funds, shall be resolutely punished according to law.

(3) Focus on Protecting Agricultural Infrastructure and Environmental Projects, and Promote the Steady Development of Rural Infrastructure and Ecological Environment Construction

1. Severely crack down on criminal acts that destroy agricultural infrastructure and environmental projects, and protect agricultural infrastructure and environmental safety. Agricultural infrastructure, with farmland water conservancy as the focus, is an important material foundation for establishing modern agriculture, improving farmers' living conditions, and promoting the construction of ecological civilization. Criminal acts that destroy farmland water conservancy projects, flood control projects, water source construction projects, water source irrigation projects, and safe drinking water projects shall be further cracked down upon, and criminal acts that hinder or destroy rural energy projects and environmental protection projects shall be severely cracked down upon to protect the safety of agricultural infrastructure projects.

2. Further strengthen the trial of cases involving agricultural infrastructure construction projects, and maintain the order of the agricultural infrastructure construction project market. Multiple measures shall be taken according to law to prevent the trial of cases from affecting the progress of construction projects, the protection of the interests of investors in small farmland water conservancy facilities, small watershed comprehensive management, and other construction projects shall be strengthened according to law, and the enthusiasm and initiative of farmers in participating in agricultural infrastructure construction shall be protected.

(4) Strengthen the Protection of New Rural Market Entities, and Promote the Establishment and Improvement of a New Type of Agricultural Socialized Service System

The protection of new types of rural market entities, such as specialized farmer cooperatives and professional service companies, shall be strengthened, the trial capacity and level for related new types of cases shall be further improved, and the legitimate rights and interests of farmers' cooperative organizations shall be protected according to law. Through the demonstration effect of judicial judgments, the development of new types of rural market entities shall be cultivated, new methods and new pathways for farmers to participate in the market shall be opened up, farmers' ability to participate in market competition through various forms shall be enhanced, and the establishment and improvement of the agricultural socialized service system shall be promoted.

(5) Adhere to the Basic State Policy of Environmental Protection, and Promote the Sustainable Development of Agriculture

Strictly implement the state's laws and administrative regulations on environmental protection, and realize the institutionalization and legalization of agricultural environmental protection. Illegal and criminal acts that violate laws and administrative regulations and destroy agricultural resources, ecological resources, biological resources, etc., shall be resolutely punished according to law. Farmers, farming households, or farmers' cooperative organizations that have suffered losses due to illegal and criminal acts of environmental destruction shall be resolutely supported in their right to claim damages according to law. The trial work on rural environmental protection shall be further promoted to achieve the sustainable development strategy. Through criminal, civil, administrative, and other trial means, the authority of various environmental protection legal systems shall be established and strengthened, the comprehensive establishment of the ecological benefit compensation system and the rural ecological protection system shall be promoted, and the steady advancement of the national sustainable development strategy shall be actively safeguarded.

4. Actively and prudently carry out work, promote comprehensive social progress in rural areas through judicial means

(1) Actively explore the trial characteristics of agriculture-related cases, promote the construction of a new socialist countryside culture

1. Fully recognize the importance of strengthening the construction of socialist morality in rural areas. Moral construction is an important factor for national development, social harmony, and people's happiness. The People's Courts must become important promoters and guarantors of moral construction, effectively play the guiding role of judicial adjudication on the ideological and moral values of rural society, promote socialist core values, continuously improve the ideological and moral quality of farmers, and vigorously advocate for a good trend of healthy, civilized, and law-abiding conduct. In the process of adjudicating ordinary civil disputes involving agriculture, such as marriage and family, inheritance, support, maintenance, and neighbor relations, it is necessary to accurately understand and apply laws such as the Marriage Law of the PRC and the Succession Law of the PRC, as well as relevant judicial interpretations. Through judicial means, advocate for socialist moral norms that advocate science, integrity and law-abiding behavior, resist superstition, and transform social traditions, promoting a social trend in rural areas of gender equality, respect for the elderly and care for the young, family harmony, neighborly harmony, achieving prosperity through hard work, and assisting the poor and needy.

2. Focus on extensive and in-depth collection, organization, and research of the positive elements of customs and habits, transforming them into effective judicial adjudication resources. It is necessary to value the positive role of good folk customs in effectively resolving social conflicts and disputes and promoting harmony and stability in the new countryside. Adhere to the principles of legality, reasonableness, legitimacy, and universality, seriously consider farmers' general moral evaluation standards, level of legal awareness, and basic criteria for judging right and wrong. Use good rural folk customs as a useful supplement to legal norms, prudently adjudicate and enforce related cases, ensuring the organic unity of legal and social effects in agriculture-related trials and enforcement.

(2) Properly handle agriculture-related medical cases, promote the development of rural medical and health services

Combat corruption and criminal conduct in the rural medical service system according to law, protect the healthy development of rural medical and health services. Developing rural medical and health services is a key step and inherent requirement for effectively protecting farmers' rights and interests, focusing on improving rural people's livelihood, and promoting social fairness. Strictly implement the national rules and regulations concerning the planning, allocation, and supervision of rural medical and health services. Resolutely punish according to law criminal acts such as misappropriation, embezzlement, and corruption of state investment funds for rural medical and health services, and acts that undermine the rural cooperative medical system, the rural basic drug distribution system, and the drug supply guarantee system. Handle agriculture-related medical dispute cases prudently, while paying attention to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of farmer patients, also fully consider the current status of rural medical and health service development, and promote the establishment and development of the rural medical and health system.

(3) Effectively ensure the use of national disaster prevention and relief funds, strengthen the construction of rural disaster prevention and relief capabilities

The effective use of national disaster prevention and relief funds is an important guarantee for strengthening the construction of rural disaster prevention and relief capabilities. Comprehensively strengthen the adjudication of cases involving agriculture-related disaster prevention and relief funds. For criminal acts with significant impact, wide scope, and serious consequences, severe punishment must be imposed. Through the maintenance of the national management system for the use of disaster prevention and relief funds, promote the continuous strengthening of rural disaster prevention and relief capabilities.

(4) Broaden the expression mechanism for rural social conditions and public opinion, promote the continuous strengthening of rural social management

1. Properly handle petition cases involving legal proceedings, fully support and actively participate in the mechanism for protecting farmers' rights led by the Party committee and guided by the government. For petitioners whose cases are still under trial, they shall be informed to continue participating in the litigation, and the relevant People's Court shall be urged to adjudicate promptly according to law. For petitioners who are dissatisfied with an effective judgment, they shall be informed to seek relief through the retrial procedure. Further strengthen the adjudication of applications for retrial involving agriculture, strictly in accordance with the revised Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, protect the parties' right to apply for retrial. Once the retrial procedure is entered, the case shall be concluded promptly according to law. For those who unreasonably persist in litigation, under the leadership of the local Party committee, the supervision of the People's Congress, and the support and cooperation of the government and village self-governing organizations, efforts shall be made to persuade them to accept the judgment.

2. Maintain high vigilance against the signs of using religious, clan, or other forces to interfere with rural reform and development affairs. For crimes involving cult organizations, organized crimes of a gangster nature, and crimes by evil forces, they must be severely cracked down upon according to law. In conjunction with the actual work of the People's Courts, actively coordinate with local governments to explore and establish a sound rural emergency management mechanism, effectively improve the capacity and level of handling crisis incidents.

5. Continue to strengthen the implementation measures of the system, ensure the continuous improvement of judicial guarantees and legal service levels

(1) Focus on promoting the establishment of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism, resolving conflicts and disputes at multiple levels

1. Vigorously strengthen support and guidance for people's mediation. In accordance with the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Adjudicating Civil Cases Involving People's Mediation Agreements, adjudicate civil cases involving people's mediation agreements with high quality and efficiency. Actively adapt to the new situation of rural reform and development, strive to improve the level of guidance for people's mediation organizations, and achieve innovation in means and methods. Be adept at fully leveraging the unique role of people's mediation organizations based on the nature, complexity of rural conflicts and disputes, and the specific circumstances of the farmer parties concerned. Guide people's mediation organizations to conduct mediation work using a combination of law, reason, and emotion, strive to improve the effectiveness of people's mediation, and promote rural social harmony and tranquility.

2. Promote the establishment of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism, resolve conflicts and disputes in a timely manner. Actively explore and steadily promote a diversified dispute resolution mechanism in rural areas. Actively guide parties to use arbitration, mediation, and other methods to resolve disputes, effectively reduce the number of levels and links in dispute resolution, and reduce the cost of resolving conflicts. Focus on linkage and collaboration with multiple dispute resolution entities such as grassroots governments and village self-governing organizations, build a full-coverage network for dispute resolution, and strive to resolve conflicts before litigation, nipping them in the bud.

3. Continue to strengthen litigation mediation, strive to achieve case conclusion and dispute resolution. Adhere to the civil trial guiding principle of "mediate where possible, adjudicate where necessary, combine mediation and adjudication, and conclude cases to resolve disputes." Increase the proportion of dispute resolution through mediation, guide parties to reach agreements on the basis of voluntary mutual concessions, and reduce confrontation between parties. Broaden the scope of application of litigation mediation, attempt new models for mediating criminal private prosecution cases and other minor criminal cases, increase the intensity of mediation in criminal incidental civil actions, explore an administrative litigation reconciliation system, and promote reconciliation during enforcement.

(2) Expand the scope and intensity of judicial assistance, demonstrate humanistic care

Fully pay attention to the judicial needs of poor rural people. Improve the specific conditions and standards for deferring, reducing, or waiving court costs for parties in financial difficulty. For farmer parties who are truly in financial difficulty, especially those in particularly difficult circumstances, in cases involving claims for child support, spousal support, personal injury compensation, or labor remuneration, actively take measures to defer, reduce, or waive court costs, ensuring that farmer parties who meet the conditions for assistance can afford to file a lawsuit.

(3) Effectively improve judicial efficiency, facilitate litigation for the people

Fully leverage the function of the summary civil procedure in resolving disputes in a timely, simple, and convenient manner. Expand the scope of application of the summary procedure according to law, achieve the separation of simple and complex cases, reduce litigation costs, and promptly protect the legitimate rights and interests of farmers. Accelerate research and exploration of the fast-track adjudication procedure system, attempt a rapid processing mechanism for small claim cases. For remote rural areas with sparse population, vast territories, and inconvenient transportation, especially ethnic minority regions, based on local specific circumstances, implement on-site case filing, on-site trial, immediate mediation, and timely pronouncement of judgment. Implement the system of informing parties of their rights and obligations and the risk of litigation, focus on strengthening litigation guidance and assistance for poor rural parties or those with low education levels.

(4) Adhere to the "three orientations," do a good job in the work of the People's Tribunals

The work of the People's Tribunals is the top priority of the basic-level work of the People's Courts. The frontline role of the People's Tribunals must be fully leveraged. In accordance with the requirement of "oriented towards rural areas, oriented towards the grassroots, oriented towards the masses," effectively carry out the work of the People's Tribunals. Through a case trial quality and efficiency evaluation system and a comprehensive tribunal supervision and evaluation system, establish a standardized, systematic, and scientific goal management operation mechanism. Focus on properly resolving issues such as personnel allocation, rank and benefits, funding, and material equipment guarantees for rural People's Tribunals, ensuring the smooth progress of the basic-level work of the People's Courts. Continue to consolidate and improve the working mechanism of direct case filing by People's Tribunals. Based on local population distribution and case volume, establish fixed case collection points outside the location of the People's Tribunal. Adhere to and improve the circuit trial system of the People's Tribunals, continuously improve the effectiveness and level of circuit trials. Improve the trial style of the People's Tribunals, emphasize trial civility. Starting from solving the most concerned, most direct, and most realistic interest issues of the vast number of farmers, strive to resolve disputes, effectively embody serving the people through justice.

(5) Continuously standardize the people's assessor system, effectively improve the management mechanism

Conscientiously implement the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Improving the People's Assessor System, fully leverage and effectively strengthen the role of people's assessors in basic-level courts, especially in People's Tribunals. Expand the recruitment of grassroots rural cadres, demobilized servicemen, and returned entrepreneurs and workers engaged in business or industry who have prestige, good character, ability, and dedication to serve as people's assessors. Effectively strengthen the training and management of rural people's assessors, vigorously publicize the people's assessor system. Ensure that rural people's assessors participate in trial activities according to law, maximizing their role. Through the improvement and development of the people's assessor system, highlight judicial democracy, continuously enhance the credibility of the people's judiciary in the vast rural areas, and improve the social effect of judicial adjudication.

In implementing the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee, People's Courts at all levels shall deeply study and practice the Scientific Outlook on Development, actively practice the important guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes," continuously enhance cohesion, increase combat effectiveness, and with high morale, full enthusiasm, and fair and efficient justice, provide strong judicial guarantees and legal services for promoting rural reform and development.
